```{r, include = FALSE}
ofce::init_qmd("rinit_ecograph.r")
library(countrycode)
library(lubridate)

lbl <- function(x, format=NULL) {
  if(is.null(format))
    if(is.null(dim(x)))
      fmt <- ifelse(max(stringr::str_length(x))==2, "eurostat", "iso3c")
    else
      fmt <- ifelse(max(stringr::str_length(x[,1]))==2, "eurostat", "iso3c")
  else
    fmt <- format
  if(is.null(dim(x)))
    return(countrycode(x, fmt, "country.name.fr"))
  x |>
    mutate(across(1, ~countrycode(.x, fmt, "country.name.fr")))
}


pays <- c("DE", "FR", "IT", "ES", "NL", "BE", "PT", "IE", "LU")
salaires <- source_data('R/salaires.r') |>
  filter(geo %in% pays)
meta <- sourcoise::sourcoise_meta("R/salaires.r")
date <- meta$data_date |> ymd_hms()
date <- stringr::str_glue("{day(date)}/{month(date)}/{year(date)}")
data <- salaires |>
  filter(time >= "1995-01-01") |>
  select(geo, time, w, wb) |>
  group_by(geo) |> 
  arrange(time) |> 
  mutate(
    t0 = min(time),
    t1 = ymd("2019-01-01"),
    t2 = max(time),
    dt1 = as.numeric(time - t0) / 365.25,
    dt2 = as.numeric(time - t1) / 365.25,
    gl = replace_na(w/lag(w,4)-1, 0),
    gl1995 = replace_na((w/w[time==t0])^(1/dt1)-1, 0),
    gl19 = replace_na((w/w[time==t1])^(1/dt2)-1)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    derniereligne = ifelse(time>t1, glue("Evolution moyenne annuelle depuis {year(t1)} : {fmt_pct(gl19,1)}/an"), ""),
    tooltip = glue(
    "{ofce::get_flags(as.character(geo), tooltip=TRUE)} <b>{lbl(geo)}</b>
    {date_trim(time)}</b>
    Salaire réel : {round(w,1)} k€/an
    Evolution sur un an : {fmt_pct(gl,1)}/an
    Evolution moyenne annuelle depuis {year(t0)} : {fmt_pct(gl1995,1)}/an
    {derniereligne}") ) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("w")) |>
  mutate(geo = factor(geo, pays))

lbl_b <- c(w = "Ttes branches", w_md = "Marchand",
                     w_nmd = "Non marchand", w_hi = "Marchand hors imm.")
lbl_bb <- c(wb = "Ttes branches", wb_md = "Marchand",
                     wb_nmd = "Non marchand", wb_hi = "Marchand hors imm.")
dw <- data |>
  filter(name == "w") |>
  drop_na(value)

# Les autres pays, répliqués dans chaque panel (hors le pays du panel)
autres <- dw |>
  select(geo_other = geo, time, value) |>
  cross_join(tibble(geo = factor(pays, pays))) |>
  filter(geo != geo_other)

# Tendances : 1995T4-2019T4 et 2019T4-dernier point (salaire sur 4 trimestres glissants)
t_break <- as.Date("2019-10-01")
trends <- dw |>
  group_by(geo) |>
  summarise(
    t0 = min(time[time >= "1995-10-01"]),
    t2 = max(time),
    v0 = value[time == t0],
    v1 = value[time == t_break],
    v2 = value[time == t2]) |>
  mutate(t1 = t_break)

trends <- bind_rows(
  trends |> transmute(geo, periode = "1", x = t0, xend = t1, y = v0, yend = v1),
  trends |> transmute(geo, periode = "2", x = t1, xend = t2, y = v1, yend = v2)) |>
  mutate(
    T_ans = as.numeric(xend - x) / 365.25,
    g = (yend / y)^(1 / T_ans) - 1,
    x_lab = x + (xend - x) / 2,
    alpha_p = ifelse(periode == "1", 0.75, 1),
    period = glue("{ofce::date_trim(x)}-{ofce::date_trim(xend)}"),
    label = scales::percent(g, accuracy = 0.1, decimal.mark = ",",
                            style_positive = "plus", suffix = " %/an"))

# Brackets sous les textes, au dessus de l'axe des dates
y_brk <- c(bas = 14.8, haut = 15.9)
y_txt <- 16.4
brk <- trends |>
  mutate(x1 = x + 120, x2 = xend - 120) |>
  reframe(
    .by = c(geo, periode, alpha_p),
    x = c(x1, x1, x2, x2),
    y = y_brk[c("haut", "bas", "bas", "haut")])

# Titre de panel : drapeau + nom du pays, en haut à gauche
titres <- tibble(geo = factor(pays, pays)) |>
  mutate(label = str_c(ofce::get_flags(as.character(geo), out = "md", size = 1)," ",
                       lbl(as.character(geo))))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-salaires
#| fig-cap: Salaires réels en Europe
#| fig-asp: 0.85

sal <- ggplot(dw) +
  aes(x=time, y=value,
      alpha = name, linewidth = name, linetype = name,
      color = geo) +
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c(w=1, w_md = 1, w_nmd = 0.75, w_hi = 0.75),
    labels = lbl_b, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(w="solid", w_md ="solid", w_nmd ="solid", w_hi = "11"),
    labels = lbl_b,
    name = NULL) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(
    values = c(w=.25, w_md = 0.1, w_nmd = 0.25, w_hi= 0.5),
    labels = lbl_b, name = NULL) +
  geom_line(
    data = autres, aes(x = time, y = value, group = geo_other),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  # courbe : 1995-2019 (alpha 0.75) puis 2019-2026, le point de rupture est commun
  geom_line(data = ~.x |> filter(time <= t_break), alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = ~.x |> filter(time >= t_break), linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_segment(
    data = trends,
    aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend, color = geo, alpha = I(alpha_p)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.1, linetype = "11") +
  geom_path(
    data = brk,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = periode, color = geo, alpha = I(alpha_p)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.1) +
  munch::geom_text_md(
    data = trends,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_txt, label = label, color = geo, alpha = I(alpha_p)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 8, size.unit = "pt",
    vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5) +
  munch::geom_text_md(
    data = trends,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_txt-1.5, label = period, color = geo, alpha = I(alpha_p)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, size.unit = "pt",
    vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5) +
  munch::geom_text_md(
    data = titres,
    aes(x = ymd("1995-02-01"), y = Inf, label = label, color = geo),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 8, size.unit = "pt",
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = ~.x |>
      filter( name == "w") |>
      group_by(geo) |>
      filter(quarter(time) == last(quarter(time))) |>
      ungroup(),
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = time),
    size = 0.2, stroke = 0, hover_nearest = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(vars(geo), ncol = 3, labeller = lbl) +
  scale_ofce_date(labels = date1) +
  ylab("Salaire annuel réel en k€") + xlab(NULL) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 50, 60),
                limits = c(14, 100)) +
  scale_color_pays(format = "eurostat") +
  theme(
    legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  guides(color = "none", fill="none", alpha = "none", linetype = "none", linewidth = "none") +
  ofce_caption(
    wrap = 0,
    source = "Eurostat, comptes nationaux trimestriels de branche (namq_10_a10), téléchargé le {date}, code à github.com/ofce/wp-xt-travail/R/salaires.r.",
    champ = "Toute l'économie, salaires y compris cotisations sociales à la charge de l'employeur.",
    lecture = "Pour chaque pays, le taux de croissance annuel moyen du salaire par tête réel est calculé sur 1995-2019 (teinte plus claire) puis sur 2019-2026, comme indiqué en bas de chaque graphique.",
    note = "Le salaire est défini comme la masse salariale (D1) divisée par l'emploi salarié, sur les 4 derniers trimestres, déflaté par le déflateur de la consommation (P31_S14) chaîné.",
    ofce = FALSE) +
  # Après ofce_caption, qui réécrit le thème
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank())

girafy(sal)
```
